title: Error-handling meta-policy
preamble:
# Error-handling meta-policy

How DS handles errors: the
four error-handling policies, and which one a
feature picks.

Every feature that surfaces error behaviour picks
exactly one of the four policies below based on a
decision tree. The policies are orthogonal — a
feature doesn't mix-and-match, and the choice is
made once at design time based on what the error
means and when it surfaces.

## What this is not

- Not a catalogue of error codes. Specific codes
  live with the feature that emits them
  ([LCRS], [LHYD], etc.).
- Not an implementation spec. How the runtime
  delivers each policy is runtime-docs territory.
- Not a runtime-error taxonomy. The language commits
  to the behavioural surface; the runtime decides
  internal representations.
